english_desc: A young woman with dark hair and glasses sits at a table with her hands near her face. She wears a black short-sleeved shirt. The background is a plain off-white wall.

A person with dark hair and glasses sits at a table with their hands clasped in front of them. They are wearing a dark shirt. The image is from a television show or video recording.

A person wearing glasses, looking to the right, wearing a light-colored jacket, against a textured background. The image shows a close-up, profile view, focusing on the person's face and upper body. The visible text is "ODG" in the top right corner.

Two people are seated at separate light wood dining tables against a plain white wall. The woman on the left has dark hair and glasses and is wearing a dark top; the man on the right has dark hair and glasses and is wearing a light gray zip-up jacket. The bottom left corner contains Korean text.
A person wearing glasses and a light gray sweater is pictured in a studio setting, smiling at the camera. Korean text is visible at the bottom.
